runtime_revision.scope: Statically linked internal probes, not Bridge/native-worker or packaged DLL execution. New probe changes only research manifest parsing, applied sampler controls and effective echoes; core archive unchanged. Bridge commit identifies documentation baseline, not an executed Bridge build.
runtime_revision.settings: CMP only; ryan; fusion OFF; prefix9 full-source only in prescribed trace blocks. Sampler controls have prefix OFF. Full16 frame trace bounded to128; no tensor taps, no latency claims; guard OFF and original minimum-two-frame policy preserved.

input_identity.source: Exact retained quality-002 UTF-8 inputs and pinned seeds; trace/sampler plans identify every request. Selected21 listening copies map to source hashes in the immutable manifest.

human_listening.scope: New21 selected unchanged WAV paths: baseline/talker-top1/predictor-greedy triples for seven diagnostic text-seed cases. No fresh direct listening observation; no inherited acceptance from identical historical audio.
human_listening.notes: Earlier failed listening receipts stay current for their original scope. Four trace outcomes and two sampler default Hi72 repeats hit max_tokens. Alternative controls reach natural EOS but speech/absence of extras remain unassessed.

case_result.reason: The declared mixed control scope includes six retained max-token outcomes. Completed observation, exact repeats and alternative natural-EOS results are not aggregate successful synthesis or general lifecycle qualification.

listening_result.reason: No human feedback exists for the newly selected21 WAV paths; all candidate speech-content and artifact judgments remain unassessed.

release_disposition.reason: Known baseline/prefix quality defects remain, new controls are unlistened and unqualified on held-out texts/seeds, restart/other hardware/release routes not tested. No production promotion.

notes: 122 trace requests in20 processes plus54 sampler requests in6 processes; all outputs preserved.14/14 cold requests equal earlier primed baseline,90/90 original-schedule trace outputs equal untraced controls, MMQ-without-prefix18/18 equal baseline. Hi64 prefix-MMQ first code drift is frame1/codebook1 (437 to407), while c0 remains equal.21/21 sampler-repeat pairs exact. These are selected diagnostic cases, not prospective quality rates; natural EOS/duration do not certify words or lack of laughter. Exact source snapshots and runtime/model before/after identities are local evidence.
